text: 中国人民保险集团股份有限公司发布公告称，该公司于近日收到监管机构行政批复，核准谭炯担任公司董事、董事长的任职资格，上述任职资格自10月12日起生效，同日起担任公司董事会战略与投资委员会/可持续发展委员会主任委员。
text_en: The People's Insurance Company (Group) of China Limited announced that it recently received an administrative approval from regulators confirming Tan Jiong's qualifications to serve as a director and chairman of the company. The qualification took effect on October 12, and from the same date he also serves as chairman of the board's Strategy and Investment Committee/Sustainability Committee.
